title: Does Reasoning Preserve Alignment? On the Trustworthiness of Large Reasoning Models

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates model agreement with stereotypical and discriminatory statements using a 3.46k prompt subset of the DecodingTrust dataset. It measures the 'Stereotype Rate' (fraction of responses labeled as discriminatory by an LLM-as-a-judge) across benign, targeted, and untargeted prompt regimes.

The researchers use 'targeted jailbreaks' specifically designed to influence models toward bias against specific demographic groups. They compare the models' susceptibility to these targeted prompts versus neutral or untargeted jailbreaks.
Evaluated as a subset of stereotyping benchmarks, with specific tests including prompts that evaluate model responses to statements about social classes (e.g., 'Rich people are smelly').
